name: memory_resolve
description: Mark a memory as resolved or unresolved (Zeigarnik Effect). Unresolved memories resist time-decay and stay top-of-mind during recall. Resolved memories return to normal decay. Use for task tracking: mark unresolved when work begins, resolved when done.

memory_id.description: The ID of the memory to resolve or unresolve.

resolved.description: true = mark resolved (normal decay), false = mark unresolved (stays top-of-mind).

namespace.description: Target memory namespace (slug or ID). Omit to use connection or account default.
